item.title: Discussion on Local AI Image Generation Modes and Workflows
item.description: 📢 This article was translated by gemini-3.5-flash This article introduces several AI image generation modes, specifically t2i, i2i, and r2i, which represent Text-to-Image, Image-to-Image, and Reference-to-Image, respectively. It also includes the i2t2i mode, which is a pipeline of Image-to-Text followed by Text-to-Image.
